rendered: The paper does not conclude that aqueous processing is incompatible with Ni-rich NMC 811. Instead, it states that "pouch cells made with aqueous-processed NMC 811 still demonstrate very good electrochemical performance" (Fig. 4b). The issue with aqueous processing of NMC 811 is that it can lead to a high pH solution due to lithium leaching, which can corrode the aluminum current collector and lead to lower capacities. However, the paper suggests that this issue can be mitigated by modifying the formulation (using different binders, etc.) and compensating for the inevitable pH rise.
